name: scroll-compression
title: Scroll Compression
description: A stack of panels that compresses together as the page scrolls — each layer's gap interpolates from loose to sealed based on scroll progress through the section, like a deck being squeezed shut.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Scroll Progress Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
